models.// decision: Nonempty Anthropic model ID for all judgment calls. Pricing matches the model ID returned by the API.
models.// max_tokens: Positive integer cap on output tokens per request.
models.// send_temperature: Boolean. Send the wrapper's 0.1 temperature only for models that accept it.

execution.// dry_run: Boolean. This checkout defaults to true for broker previews only. false requests live execution, which also requires explicit release approval and all submission gates.
execution.// mcp_url: HTTP(S) broker MCP endpoint URL. The client uses this endpoint for quotes, account reconciliation and orders.
execution.// tradability_fail_mode: closed rejects missing or failed tradability checks. open tolerates unknown status. An explicitly untradeable ticker is always rejected.
execution.// min_dollar_volume: Minimum estimated 30-day average dollar volume in USD for entries. Independent of the discovery liquidity screen.
execution.// live_release_approved: Boolean. This checkout defaults to false. true records owner approval for live submission when dry_run is false and all runtime guards pass.
execution.// quote_max_age_seconds: Positive seconds. Maximum age of a source-timestamped quote for protection and live execution. Receipt time cannot replace it.
execution.// reconciliation_max_age_seconds: Positive seconds. Maximum age of the verified holdings snapshot for live execution. Open-order reconciliation is also required.
execution.// manual_stop_file: Nonempty absolute path or path relative to the repository. Its presence blocks each live submission, including hard stops and rotation legs.
execution.// extended_hours_enabled: Reserved. false is the only supported value. true fails validation because extended-hours order behavior is unverified.

logging.// level: Console log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL). The diagnostic file continues at DEBUG.

trading.// max_positions: Positive integer limit on distinct holdings and reserved buy slots. Adds do not use a new slot.
trading.// max_position_pct: Maximum position fraction of account equity (0 to 1). Also caps the sizing ladder and adds.
trading.// edge_score_threshold: Minimum total edge score for entries and adds. SELL is exempt.
trading.// take_profit_pct: Deprecated. The live graduation threshold is exits.take_profit_pct. This legacy value does not change exits.
trading.// profit_review_pct: Deprecated. The old percent-only profit review is superseded by grouped exit advisories.
trading.// max_holding_days: Positive integer of NYSE sessions since a known entry. Queues a nightly advisory when monitor.check_max_holding and exits.enabled are true.
trading.// cycle_edge_bonus: Finite score increments keyed by OPEN, MID and CLOSE. Added to the base threshold for BUY and ROTATE only.
trading.// stop_loss_bands: Pairs of annualized 30-day volatility percent floor and negative loss fraction greater than -1. The highest matching floor sets the initial stop.
trading.// size_ladder: Pairs of edge score floor and equity fraction in (0, 1]. The highest matching floor supplies base size before volatility and exposure limits.
trading.// vol_sizing: Pairs of annualized 30-day volatility percent floor and size multiplier in (0, 1]. Below the first floor or with unknown volatility, the multiplier is 1.
trading.// extreme_vol_reject_30d: Reject new buys above this annualized 30-day volatility in percent units (120 means 120%).

market_hours.// calendar: Fixed to NYSE. This calendar governs trading sessions, holidays and early closes.
market_hours.// stale_data_guard: Boolean. Require a fresh, positive SPY benchmark quote before scheduled decisions. Per-order quote gates apply independently.

trading.// max_new_entries_per_day: Nonnegative integer count of new entries before additional portfolio justification is required. Adds are exempt.
trading.// sector_cap_pct: Sector exposure review threshold as a fraction of equity (0 to 1). A trade above the threshold requires explicit sector justification.
trading.// earnings_window_discount_notches: Nonnegative integer number of sizing ladder steps to reduce after earnings-window review.

add_to_position.// enabled: Boolean. Allow the typed ADD action subject to evidence, exit priority, liquidity, size and incremental risk checks.
add_to_position.// max_adds_per_position: Nonnegative integer limit on confirmed adds to the current position lifecycle.
add_to_position.// max_increment_pct_of_position_value: Maximum add size as a fraction (0, 1] of the current position value.
add_to_position.// max_incremental_risk_fraction_of_equi: Maximum incremental loss to the existing stop as a fraction (0, 1) of equity.
add_to_position.// cooldown_hours: Nonnegative hours since the last confirmed add.
add_to_position.// require_valid_existing_stop: Fixed true. Adds require a valid stop below the execution price to bound incremental risk.

schedule.// open_hour: OPEN cycle wall-clock time in schedule.timezone. Hour is integer 0-23, minute 0-59. NYSE must also be open.
schedule.// mid_hour: MID cycle wall-clock time in schedule.timezone. Hour is integer 0-23, minute 0-59. Schedule it after OPEN.
schedule.// close_hour: CLOSE cycle wall-clock time in schedule.timezone. Hour is integer 0-23, minute 0-59. Schedule it after MID and before the session ends.
schedule.// timezone: IANA zone for decision cycles, startup catch-up, and attribution. Discovery hours labeled ET use America/New_York.

monitor.// enabled: Boolean. Register the recurring position monitor during NYSE sessions. Decision cycles can also run a protection pass.
monitor.// historicals_span: Broker lookback for metrics used in advisory reviews. day, week, month, 3month, 6month or year. Nightly ATR uses its own daily history.
monitor.// interval_seconds: Integer polling interval of at least 5 seconds. Monitor health allows the larger of 90 seconds or two intervals.
monitor.// profit_review_cooldown_min: Nonnegative minutes before retrying a failed soft exit advisory other than graduation. Hard stops do not wait.
monitor.// profit_target_cooldown_min: Nonnegative minutes before retrying a failed graduation review. A completed graduation review is one-time per holding.
monitor.// check_max_holding: Boolean. Enable the nightly time-in-position advisory from trading.max_holding_days. It never forces a sale.

watchlist.// default_tickers: Array of ticker strings for fallback when discovery is off and the legacy selector or broker watchlist has no usable list.
watchlist.// robinhood_watchlist_name: Nonempty broker watchlist name for fallback when discovery is off and the legacy selector has no usable list.

news.// provider: Fixed to finnhub. The agent has one news provider.
news.// lookback_days: Positive integer calendar-day query range for decision-cycle company news. Weekly selection uses a separate lookback.
news.// max_per_ticker: Positive integer maximum number of fresh headlines attached per ticker.
news.// fresh_window_hours: Maximum age in whole hours of stories included in decision and monitor prompts.

general_market.// enabled: Boolean. Include Finnhub market headlines in the SPY news context.
general_market.// category: Finnhub market news category string. Use general for broad coverage or a category the provider accepts.
general_market.// count: Nonnegative integer cap on fetched market headlines. SPY's combined context is also limited by max_per_ticker.

cost_tracking.// enabled: Boolean. Write Anthropic usage and cost records and report cycle totals. It has no effect on trading eligibility or API requests.
cost_tracking.// pricing: Exact returned model ID to rates map. Rates are nonnegative USD per million tokens. Unknown models or billable categories remain unpriced.

claude-sonnet-5-5.// cache_write: Rate for five-minute cache creation tokens.
claude-sonnet-5-5.// cache_write_1h: Rate for one-hour cache creation tokens.

pricing.// *: Deprecated wildcard tariff. Ignored so unknown models stay unpriced.

cost_tracking.// pricing_version: Nonempty rate revision label stored in the ledger with billed usage and the selected rates.

sentiment_selection.// enabled: Boolean. Enable the legacy weekly selector when discovery is off, plus sentiment refresh for held positions.
sentiment_selection.// universe_size: Positive integer legacy weekly quota. The integrated agent counts new candidates separately from holdings.
sentiment_selection.// lookback_days: Positive integer calendar-day headline query range for legacy selection. Discovery uses its fixed 45-day baseline.
sentiment_selection.// min_sentiment_score: Minimum legacy mean headline score from -1 to 1 for a candidate.
sentiment_selection.// schedule_day: Legacy weekly APScheduler day-of-week expression, such as sun or mon-fri.
sentiment_selection.// schedule_hour: Legacy selection wall-clock time in schedule_timezone. Hour is integer 0-23 and minute 0-59.
sentiment_selection.// schedule_timezone: IANA zone for the legacy weekly ranking schedule.
sentiment_selection.// model_name: Informational only. The primary model ID and pinned revision are defined in core/data/sentiment.py.
sentiment_selection.// fallback_model: Informational only. The fallback ID and pinned revision are defined in core/data/sentiment.py.
sentiment_selection.// batch_size: Positive integer number of headlines per inference batch for legacy weekly selection. Discovery uses its own default.
sentiment_selection.// cache_max_age_hours: Nonnegative hours to reuse an identical weekly or discovery headline query. Zero disables cache reuse.

reporting.// attribution_enabled: Boolean. Schedule live and paper fill attribution on weekdays.
reporting.// attribution_hour: Attribution wall-clock time in schedule.timezone. Hour is integer 0-23 and minute 0-59.

discovery.// enabled: Boolean. Use the S&P discovery pipeline for new names. Missing or stale shortlists leave the new-name set empty. Held positions are reviewed separately.
discovery.// universe_file: Nonempty absolute or repository-relative path to the sourced, versioned constituent snapshot.
discovery.// shortlist_file: Nonempty absolute or repository-relative path to the published shortlist. Failure status is written next to it.
discovery.// features_dir: Nonempty absolute or repository-relative directory for dated feature snapshots. Latest feature output also has a fixed path under data.
discovery.// universe_max_age_days: Positive maximum age in days of the source constituent snapshot.
discovery.// shortlist_max_age_days: Positive maximum age in days for a published shortlist to supply new names.
discovery.// min_cohort: Minimum number of valid feature and news rows needed to publish a ranking.

gates.// min_dollar_volume: Positive minimum 30-session average daily turnover in USD before ranking. Execution checks its own floor.
gates.// min_price: Positive minimum share price in USD.
gates.// max_vol_30d_pct_annualized: Positive maximum annualized 30-session volatility in percent units.
gates.// min_bars: Positive minimum count of contiguous completed daily bars. Individual features may require longer history.

shortlist.// new_candidate_count: Positive integer maximum new names published. Existing holdings do not consume these slots.
shortlist.// divergence_pool_cap: Positive integer maximum size of the A/B divergence pool before combining the candidate pools.
shortlist.// drift_pool_cap: Positive integer maximum size of the C confirmed drift pool before combining the candidate pools.
shortlist.// candidate_memory_runs: Positive integer number of successful shortlist runs retained for tie-breaking. It never outranks a larger gap score.

gap_weights.// sentiment_mean: Finite weight on standardized headline tone in the news component.
gap_weights.// velocity: Finite weight on standardized news-velocity in the news component.
gap_weights.// delta: Finite weight on standardized change in sentiment in the news component.
gap_weights.// momentum_blend: Two finite weights for 21- and 63-session returns, respectively. The resulting momentum component is standardized and subtracted.
gap_weights.// recent_move: Finite weight on the standardized five-session return subtracted from the raw news gap.

archetypes.// lagged_gap_z: Minimum standardized gap for A (lagged good news). Also requires a technical fingerprint.
archetypes.// inflection_delta: Minimum raw sentiment delta for B (early inflection). Also requires the base fingerprint.
archetypes.// avoid_gap_z: Gap z-score at or below which D (avoid-side) takes precedence over other labels.

fingerprints.// pullback_min: F1 lower and upper fractional distance from the 30-session high (0 to 1).
fingerprints.// uptrend_slope_min: Minimum fractional 20-session slope of the 20-day average for F1.
fingerprints.// base_range_ratio_max: Maximum recent-to-prior range ratio for F2 (base contraction).
fingerprints.// base_vol_ratio_max: Maximum recent-to-prior volatility ratio for F2.
fingerprints.// down_volume_ratio_max: Maximum recent-to-prior down-day volume ratio for F2 and F3.
fingerprints.// exhaustion_min: F3 lower and upper fractional distance from the 30-session high (0 to 1). Lower down-volume is also required.

schedule.// feature_hour_et: Daily discovery feature refresh hour in New York time (0-23). Held-position maintenance has its own 20:00 ET job.
schedule.// rank_day: APScheduler day-of-week expression for discovery ranking, such as sun. Startup uses the same schedule to detect a missed run.
schedule.// rank_hour_et: Discovery ranking hour in New York time (0-23), at minute zero. Ranking also refreshes its own feature inputs.

exits.// enabled: Boolean. Enable strategic trailing, graduation and soft review handling. Initial and previously persisted hard stops remain enforced.
exits.// breakeven_ratchet_pct: Fractional peak gain that activates the profit-lock ratchet. Must be above the lock gain and below chandelier activation.
exits.// breakeven_lock_gain_pct: Positive fractional gain locked above entry at the ratchet. Existing stops can only tighten in regular operation.

chandelier.// activate_at_pct: Peak gain fraction below 1 that activates the ATR-based trail when completed-session ATR is fresh.
chandelier.// atr_multiple: Positive number of ATRs subtracted from the observed peak for the Chandelier trail.
chandelier.// atr_period: Fixed to 14 completed-session true ranges for Wilder ATR. Other periods are unsupported.

exits.// take_profit_mode: Fixed to graduate. Crossing the threshold requests a one-time review, with a defended HOLD continuing the trail.
exits.// take_profit_pct: Fractional gain that queues the graduation review. This threshold does not itself place a sell order.

climax.// rsi_min: Minimum RSI (0-100) for a climax advisory, paired with the deviation threshold.
climax.// sigma_above_20dma: Minimum number of standard deviations above the 20-day average for a climax advisory.
climax.// tighten_atr_multiple: Positive ATR multiple for the tightened climax trail below the observed peak.

trend_break.// ma_days: Positive integer moving-average window for the trend-break test.
trend_break.// consecutive_closes: Positive integer count of sessions closing below the corresponding moving average to signal trend break.
trend_break.// only_if_was_profitable: Boolean. Restrict trend-break review to holdings that have observed a peak above entry.

sentiment_reversal.// delta_z: Maximum sentiment-delta z-score for reversal. Negative recent tone and elevated news velocity are also required.
sentiment_reversal.// news_velocity_multiple: Minimum news count multiple relative to the ticker's baseline for a reversal.

exits.// gap_closure_z: Remaining signed gap z-score below which a comparable entry gap qualifies for closure review. Sign inversions also qualify.

dead_money.// trading_days: Minimum completed NYSE sessions since known entry before dead-money review.
dead_money.// unrealized_band_pct: Maximum absolute unrealized gain/loss fraction for the dead-money rule.
dead_money.// gap_progress_min: Required progress fraction toward closing the entry gap. Below this, a holding inside the return band may qualify for review.

exits.// rotation_margin_z: Minimum new-candidate advantage in comparable gap z-score for an opportunity-cost advisory.

partial_take.// enabled: Boolean. Permit an explicit SELL/REDUCE decision when strategic exits are enabled and the gain meets at_pct.
partial_take.// at_pct: Minimum fractional gain at the executable price for the optional REDUCE action. It does not queue an automatic sale.
partial_take.// fraction: Fraction (0, 1] of current shares to sell on an eligible REDUCE. Invalid or disabled reductions are rejected.

specialized_review.// drop_pct_threshold: Minimum fractional decline from the recent peak for an intraday drop advisory.
specialized_review.// vol_aware: Boolean. Raise the drop threshold to the ATR-based floor when fresh ATR is available.
specialized_review.// drop_atr_multiple: Positive number of ATRs used in the volatility-aware drop threshold.
specialized_review.// fifty_two_week_high_review: Boolean. Queue a review when price reaches a known 52-week high.
specialized_review.// review_cooldown_hours: Nonnegative hours before an eligible intraday specialized advisory can rearm.
specialized_review.// new_high_rearm_atr_multiple: Required additional advance in ATRs before a repeat high review can rearm.

pead.// enabled: Boolean. Enable the post-earnings drift advisory with verified event data and sufficient comparable history.
pead.// min_sessions_after_earnings: Minimum completed sessions after earnings before measuring a drift exit signal.
pead.// capture_fraction_threshold: Fraction of expected positive abnormal return captured to trigger review.
pead.// max_drift_sessions: Session age that triggers review when the drift evidence is otherwise valid.
pead.// min_comparable_events: Minimum count of prior same-direction comparable earnings events for the expected drift curve.
